title: Help pick the best animation for Id|le's logo
excerpt: I built an animation picker: swipe through a dozen animations for Id|le's logo and help me pick the one that opens the story. No sign-up. Then try the game it opens: a little world of words and creatures, in your browser.
content_html:
🧪 data lab · your team

Messages arrive at the inbox. Each stage is a classifier creature: a real text classifier from Jeffy. The three it starts with (spam, support tickets, mood) run right in your browser after a one-time 23.7 MB download; any other head you pick is asked on Jeffy's server. A filter drops what matches into its own bin; a router sorts into a bin per label, and sends anything it is not sure about to review; a tagger stamps a label and passes it on.

one message every 4 s
